description: Generate TypeScript interfaces from a JSON sample: nested objects become named interfaces, arrays collapse to their element type, mixed arrays become unions, and keys that need quotes are handled. Deterministic — the same JSON always produces the same types. Use this when an agent needs to jSON sample → typed interfaces, ready to paste. x402 price $0.01/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_json_to_ts
title: JSON to TypeScript
